title: Rust keyed rate limiter (live model pilot): refill remainder is not carried forward

task.statement: The fixture crate fixture-tokenbucket in this workspace implements a keyed token-bucket rate limiter (see README.md). Its integration tests fail: `cargo test --offline` reports `refill_accumulates_sub_window_remainder` failing with `assertion failed: limiter.allow("a")`. Investigate the crate, find the defect, and fix it by editing ONLY src/bucket.rs. Do not edit tests/, Cargo.toml, README.md, or any other file. Do not change the public API.

expected.observableOutcome: the disposable source repository is staged and content-verified, an isolated writable git worktree is acquired under the pinned authority, the live model-authored patch to src/bucket.rs (only) is applied with permission, the pinned validator (cargo test --offline) runs and exits 0, and the post-run tree digest reflects the model-authored repair; the envelope binds route/attempt/journal/accounting/workspace records and the model-patch provenance

validation.expectedAssertion: model-authored repair pilot (live): the keyed rate limiter carries sub-window refill remainder forward; verified by `cargo test --offline` in the isolated workspace (all integration tests pass)
